summary: This note is the casting section of the Wikipedia article on the film 13 Hours: The Secret Soldiers of Benghazi. It records the actors signed or set to play members of the six-man security team and one undercover CIA officer in Libya, with dates from January to May 2015. The roles include a former Navy SEAL lead, a sniper, a former Marine with weapons expertise, and other team members.
one_line: Casting timeline for the 2016 film 13 Hours: The Secret Soldiers of Benghazi, listing actors added to its security team roles in early 2015.
key_facts: On January 14, 2015, John Krasinski was cast in the film to play one of the lead roles, a former US Navy SEAL.
On February 3, 2015, Pablo Schreiber signed on to play Kris "Tanto" Paronto, one of the six-man security team.
On February 6, 2015, James Badge Dale was set to star as the leader of the security team.
Max Martini was cast as another member of the security team on February 17, 2015.
On March 3, 2015, David Denman signed on to star in the film as Boon, an elite sniper.
On March 5, 2015, THR reported that Dominic Fumusa signed on to play John "Tig" Tiegen, a security team member who is a former Marine with weapons expertise.
On March 17, 2015, Freddie Stroma was added to the cast to play an undercover CIA officer in Libya.
On May 7, 2015, Toby Stephens was set to play Glen "Bub" Doherty, another of the security team members.
The film's security team consisted of six men, and the casting section describes each actor's role within that team.
Pablo Schreiber, Dominic Fumusa and Toby Stephens were cast as members of the security team, while James Badge Dale was set to lead it.
